meta_verdict.question: does coupling anima to physical hardware address the GOAL bottleneck (§1.1 data-regime / §95 synchronous-substrate ceiling)?
meta_verdict.reason: the §1.1 ceiling is about what anima learned (data diversity); the §95 ceiling is about synchronous-vs-event-driven hosting. A sensor, an entropy source, and an actuator are a yardstick, a noise ingredient, and an output display — none is a data-diversity source, none changes the substrate. Hardware coupling is honest plumbing, not a path to emergence.
